summary: Narrow frontend re-verification of iteration_93's single HIGH finding (multi-Source-of-Supply guard bypass). The fix `const selectedSosOption = selectedSosKey === "" ? null : sosOptions[Number(selectedSosKey)];` (ProductionConfirmationPage.js line 517) is CORRECT and VERIFIED live. Ran iteration_93's exact repro plus positive path plus a single-option regression, with POST /api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order route-intercepted (fulfilled with a fake job_id) so no real SAP write occurred. 3/3 scenarios pass. No new issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Optional defence-in-depth (not blocking): createProposal() still derives logistic_relationship_uuid from an index lookup; storing the chosen option object in state would make the sentinel bug class impossible to reintroduce.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic super_admin auth_user (2a94b71e-...:TEST-QA-OID) + auth_session via /app/backend/tests/_setup_pc_session.py - both deleted after testing. Fake job_ids (FAKE_JOB / FAKE_JOB_2) only ever lived client-side; localStorage key productionConfirmationActiveJobs was cleared at the end of the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified details: HTBS-SPAIN returns exactly 2 SoS options (HTBS-SPAIN_1/Site P2 uuid FA163E18-1C7B-1FE0-A99D-1FFB40FD7F05, HTBS-SPAIN_2/Site P3); trigger correctly shows placeholder 'Choose a Production Model' with nothing picked, the bold 'must pick one' warning (data-testid=sos-choice-required-warning) renders, Site stays blank. Typing Site 'P2' manually and clicking create-proposal-submit-button now fires ONLY the toast 'This material has multiple valid Production Models - pick one...' with ZERO POSTs (route interception confirmed 0 hits). After picking option 0, Site auto-fills to P2 and submit POSTs logistic_relationship_uuid=FA163E18-1C7B-1FE0-A99D-1FFB40FD7F05. Regression: MAZ42117272-TA (1 option) auto-picks itself + auto-fills Site P2, no warning shown, submits with uuid FA163E48-7A8A-1FE1-90D8-89B64583773B. SoS lookup took ~20-40s in this run (blur on create-proposal-product-input triggers it).
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_93 RCA (Number('')===0 resolving the unselected sentinel to sosOptions[0]) was accurate; the explicit empty-string check now returns null so both the guard and the null logistic_relationship_uuid path behave as intended. No residual bypass found.
